swap_constraints.summary: Propose two edges e1 = (u, v), e2 = (x, y) and candidate rewiring e1' = (u, y), e2' = (x, v) (or (u, x), (v, y) in Scheme I). Reject if e1' or e2' creates a self-loop (u = y or x = v), duplicates an existing edge (multi-edge collision), or (in Scheme II) violates sub-interface membership or chain-bipartite orientation. Detailed balance / self-loop persistence: when a proposed swap is rejected, the Markov chain retains the current graph state G_{t+1} = G_t (lazy/Metropolis-Hastings persistence), ensuring a symmetric transition matrix P(G -> G') = P(G' -> G) and a uniform stationary distribution pi(G) = const over the connected component of reachable simple graphs.

stub_difference_conservation_identity.algebraic_proof: Let S_C = 2 E_CC + E_CN be the total number of CTD half-edge stubs and S_N = 2 E_NN + E_CN be the total number of NTD half-edge stubs across all 204 contact edges (S_C + S_N = 2 * 204 = 408). Subtracting the two identities eliminates E_CN identically: S_C - S_N = 2 (E_CC - E_NN) <=> E_CC - E_NN = (S_C - S_N) / 2. Consequently, in EVERY degree-and-color-preserving graph realization (under both Scheme I and Scheme II), E_CC - E_NN is strictly constant (variance = 0.0) and serves purely as a mathematical conservation invariant and MCMC implementation check, NOT an empirical significance statistic, whereas total same-domain contacts E_same = E_CC + E_NN = 204 - E_CN varies in steps of +/- 2 whenever a swap exchanges {NTD-NTD, CTD-CTD} <-> {NTD-CTD, NTD-CTD}.

polaris_2024_colored_configuration_model.distinct_role_in_m7_level3: Defines the colored multigraph configuration model preserving both the vertex degree sequence and the joint color-pair contact matrix; transferring this framework to a simple, chain-bipartite protein contact graph requires explicit simple-graph collision rejection (no self-loops, no multi-edges) and chain-bipartite endpoint constraints, and when the 2x2 NTD/CTD color matrix is NOT held fixed (so domain assortativity can be tested), the marginal stub counts S_N and S_C still algebraically lock E_CC - E_NN = (S_C - S_N) / 2 while allowing E_same = E_CC + E_NN to vary in steps of +/- 2.

swap_constraints.summary: Propose two edges e1 = (u, v), e2 = (x, y) and candidate rewiring e1' = (u, y), e2' = (x, v) (or (u, x), (v, y) in Scheme I). stub_difference_conservation_identity.algebraic_proof: Let S_C = 2 E_CC + E_CN be the total number of CTD half-edge stubs and S_N = 2 E_NN + E_CN be the total number of NTD half-edge stubs across all 204 contact edges (S_C + S_N = 2 * 204 = 408). Subtracting the two identities eliminates E_CN identically: S_C - S_N = 2 (E_CC - E_NN) <=> E_CC - E_NN = (S_C - S_N) / 2. Consequently, in EVERY degree-and-color-preserving graph realization (under both Scheme I and Scheme II), E_CC - E_NN is strictly constant (variance = 0.0) and serves purely as a mathematical conservation invariant and MCMC implementation check, NOT an empirical significance statistic, whereas total same-domain contacts E_same = E_CC + E_NN = 204 - E_CN varies in steps of +/- 2 whenever a swap exchanges {NTD-NTD, CTD-CTD} <-> {NTD-CTD, NTD-CTD}.

polaris_2024_colored_configuration_model.distinct_role_in_m7_level3: Defines the colored multigraph configuration model preserving both the vertex degree sequence and the joint color-pair contact matrix; transferring this framework to a simple, chain-bipartite protein contact graph requires explicit simple-graph collision rejection (no self-loops, no multi-edges) and chain-bipartite endpoint constraints, and when the 2x2 NTD/CTD color matrix is NOT held fixed (so domain assortativity can be tested), the marginal stub counts S_N and S_C still algebraically lock E_CC - E_NN = (S_C - S_N) / 2 while allowing E_same = E_CC + E_NN to vary in steps of +/- 2.

stub_difference_conservation_identity.algebraic_proof: Let S_C = 2 E_CC + E_CN be the total number of CTD half-edge stubs and S_N = 2 E_NN + E_CN be the total number of NTD half-edge stubs across all 204 contact edges (S_C + S_N = 2 * 204 = 408). Subtracting the two identities eliminates E_CN identically: S_C - S_N = 2 (E_CC - E_NN) <=> E_CC - E_NN = (S_C - S_N) / 2. Consequently, in EVERY degree-and-color-preserving graph realization (under both Scheme I and Scheme II), E_CC - E_NN is strictly constant (variance = 0.0) and serves purely as a mathematical conservation invariant and MCMC implementation check, NOT an empirical significance statistic, whereas total same-domain contacts E_same = E_CC + E_NN = 204 - E_CN varies in steps of +/- 2 whenever a swap exchanges {NTD-NTD, CTD-CTD} <-> {NTD-CTD, NTD-CTD}.
